title: Someone is running Qwen 27B at ~20 tok/s on a jailbroken PS5's GPU
script:
Twenty tokens per second running Qwen on a jailbroken PlayStation five.
Alibaba released the twenty-seven billion parameter model in August twenty twenty-six.
Developer cobanov and abhi two forty-five y built the PS5 LM projects.
Sony locked the custom graphics hardware down to block custom code execution.
Local runners bypass those limits to test massive weights on console silicon.
Would you hack your console to run local models?
